markersAndScriptNames: NOVI_Barrel (script name used by WatchBarrels GetThingsWithScriptName / GetThingWithScriptName)

phases.exit: InstructionGiven_Barrels becomes true (by this or any other barrel)

operations.lua: if not NOVI.frame(quest, me) then return end

operations.note: re-read every iteration, so another barrel setting it ends this loop too

operations.lua: if not NOVI.frame(quest, me) then return end
local onXbox = NOVI.is_xbox(quest); key = onXbox and TEXT_BREAK_BARRELS or TEXT_BREAK_BARRELS_PC
operations.evidence: native asm 0xdb7eb8 + Forge direct virtual binding

operations.native: GSI->DisplayGameInfo(key); while (!GSI->MsgIsGameInfoClickedPast()) { NewScriptFrame; if terminating return }
operations.lua: quest:DisplayGameInfo(key); while not quest:MsgIsGameInfoClickedPast() do if not NOVI.frame(quest, me) then return false end end

operations.native: the active entity's bound CScriptThing fails its alive predicate; PARENT->BarrelBrokenInstantaneous = true; PARENT->BarrelBrokenPersistent = true
operations.lua: F.set(quest, F.BarrelBrokenInstantaneous, true); F.set(quest, F.BarrelBrokenPersistent, true)
operations.evidence: retail allocator/vtable + donor predicate symbols + Forge host + runtime bad=1
operations.note: Destroyed/removed barrel death is the predicate failure; Forge checks the bound thing's native IsAlive and invokes env.OnPredicateFail(Quest, Me) once before host release.

missingOn: terminate (retail returns without dismissing the box)

coupling: Quest-level thread WatchBarrels (0x00DBE890, not part of this entity) collects all things named NOVI_Barrel, clears BarrelBrokenInstantaneous each time it sees it set and counts breaks: first break -> AddBadDeed(PARENT, 0); break number (count-1) -> AddItemToContainer(NOVI_Barrel thing, OBJECT_GOLD_1); breaks beyond (count-4) -> CreateCreature(CREATURE_OAKVALE_STAG_BEETLE at BarrelBrokenPos, script NOVI_CreatedBeetle) + EntitySetMaxHealth(2.0, true). It stops when AttackOver is set.
NOVI_BarrelMan reads BarrelBrokenPersistent for his LETDOWN_BROKEN / LETDOWN_NOT_BROKE line.
InstructionGiven_Barrels is shared by all barrels: the first one the hero approaches shows the instruction, the rest skip it.
